links.comparator_used: Naive performance estimates from labels observed only after clinicians act on the model (no randomization, unweighted)
links.outcome: Accuracy of estimated model performance (AUROC) during monitoring of deployed models under label selection feedback
links.effect: Naive AUROC estimates on the observed population undershoot actual performance by up to 20%; injected randomization combined with weighted estimates recovers true model performance
links.quote: We propose an altered deployment procedure, one that combines injected randomization with traditional weighted estimates, and find it recovers true model performance.

design_hint: injected randomization with causal weighting for post-deployment performance monitoring
